jcr_content.jcr:description: The Embedded Starterkit STKxE39S is an evaluation kit designed for embedded computing engineers. It is built on the TQMxE39S platform, featuring Intel Atom®
jcr_content.keywords: Embedded Starterkit, TQMxE39S, Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900, Apollo Lake-I, Triple Display Support, Dual/Quad-Core Processors, High-Speed Communication, Low-Power, Flexible Storage.

textwithimage.text:
based on TQMxE39S Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900 Apollo Lake-I

The Embedded Starterkit STKxE39S is an evaluation kit designed for embedded computing engineers. It is built on the TQMxE39S platform, featuring Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900 processors (Apollo Lake-I). This kit supports triple display outputs with DP/HDMI (up to 4K UHD) and eDP/LVDS interfaces, providing impressive user experiences. With dual/quad-core processors capable of speeds up to 2.5 GHz, it targets small, low-power, and low-cost applications in the embedded mobile market. The module follows the SGET Standard SMARC 2.0, offering high-speed communication interfaces like Gigabit Ethernet, PCIe, USB 3.0, and 6Gbps SATA. It also includes onboard eMMC storage options and flexibility for Dual-Channel LVDS or native eDP, reducing overall BOM cost.

text.text:
Features

  • Triple Display Support: Offers triple display support with DP/HDMI (up to 4K UHD) and eDP/LVDS interfaces for impressive visuals.
  • Dual/Quad-Core Processors: Equipped with processors capable of speeds up to 2.5 GHz for diverse computing tasks.
  • High-Speed Communication: Provides high-speed communication through Gigabit Ethernet, PCIe, USB 3.0, and 6Gbps SATA.
  • Compact and Low-Power: Designed for small, low-power, and cost-effective embedded mobile applications.
  • Flexible Storage: Features onboard eMMC storage options and flexibility for Dual-Channel LVDS or native eDP.

CPU
  • Intel Atom® x5/x7 E3900 (Apollo Lake-I)
  • x5-E3930 2x 1.3/1.8 GHz, 6.5 W

Memory
  • DDR4-2/4/8 GB
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
  • eMMC - 8-64 GB
Graphics
  • 1x Digital Display Interface (DDI) for DP 1.2a, HDMI 1.4b
  • 1x eDP 1.4/Dual Channel LVDS
  • 1x HDMI 1.4b
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 1x Gbti Ethernet
  • USB - 2x USB3.0 | 4x USB 2.0 | 1x USB 2.0 OTG
  • Serial Ports - 2x Serial Port
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 4x PCIe 2.0
  • SD Card - 1x SD card
  • I2C
  • SATA - 1x SATA 3.0
  • SPI - SPI (for external UEFI BIOS flash)
  • Audio - Intel HD Audio
  • MIPI - 2x MIPI CSI
General
  • Dimensions - 85mm x 50mm
  • Plug-in System - SMARC 2.0/2.1
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C 
  • Power supply - 4.75 V - 5.25 V, 3 V Battery for RTC
  • Power consumption - typ. 3 - 8 W/max. 14 W (Green ECO-Off: < 0.1 W)
